title_sq: Tek 5 Maji, Shitet Apartament 2+1 Me Hapesira Te Bollshme !!
description_sq: Tek 5 Maji prane Shkolles Tirana Jone Shitet Apartament 2+1 Me Hapesira Te Bollshme. Apartamenti ka siperfqe bruto 95 m2, neto 84.5 m2 dhe ndodhet ne katin e fundit te nje pallati 7-katesh te mireadministruar pa ashensor (kane aplikuar banoret ne bashki per ta vendosur). Apartamenti eshte i organizuar ne dhomen e ndenjes se bashku me kendin e gatimit, nje dhome gjumi matrimoniale me dalje ne ballkon, nje dhome per femije dhe nje tualet. Orientimi i apartamenti eshte Jug-Perendim cka mundeson ndricim natyral dhe diell gjate gjithe dites. Apartamenti disponon dokumentacion te plote hipotekor dhe shitet me cmim 13.500.000 leke.
title_en: Until May 5, 2+1 apartment with ample space for sale!!
description_en: On May 5 near our Tirana School, 2+1 Apartment for Sale with Ample Spaces. The apartment has a gross area of ​​95 m2, net 84.5 m2 and is located on the top floor of a well-managed 7-story building without an elevator (residents applied to the municipality to place it). The apartment is organized in a living room with a kitchenette, a double bedroom with access to the balcony, a children's room and a toilet. The orientation of the apartment is South-West, which allows natural light and sun throughout the day. The apartment has full mortgage documentation and is sold at the price of 13,500,000 lek.
